# Getting help

- Ask usage and integration questions in the
  [LSF Discord community](https://discord.gg/mhwK2QFNBA).
- Start with the
  [guides and API reference](https://mrdav30.github.io/FixedMathSharp/).
- Report bugs and propose features through
  [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mrdav30/FixedMathSharp/issues). Include the
  package version, standard or Lean profile, target framework, transport, and a
  small reproduction when reporting a bug.
- Report vulnerabilities privately using the [security policy](../SECURITY.md).

For contributions, see [Contributing](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Please follow our
[Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) in all project spaces.
